_description: POST /api/agents/prompt — Creates a prompt agent with an Azure AI Search grounding tool.
_notes: connectionName must match a connection listed by GET /api/connections?type=AzureAISearch.
queryType is optional. Supported values: Simple, Semantic, Full, VectorSimpleHybrid, VectorSemanticHybrid.
topK is optional. Defaults to the connection's configured value.
instructions: You are a product expert. Always ground your answers in the official product documentation retrieved from Azure AI Search.
description: Agent that answers questions using Azure AI Search over product docs.
